# Copilot Instructions for 2048.poki2.online

You are working on a 2048-focused SEO gaming site.

## Objectives

- Rank long-tail keywords such as "2048 unblocked", "2048 cupcakes", "2048 3d", and "2048 multiplayer".
- Keep pages unique and useful, not thin iframe wrappers.
- Improve dwell time using related-game links and short strategy blocks.

## Hard Rules

- Every page must have unique `title`, `meta description`, `H1`, and intro paragraph.
- Provide at least 200 words of original copy per game page.
- Keep canonical URLs stable and self-referencing.
- Do not publish fabricated ratings or fake review counts in schema.
- Optimize for mobile first: no horizontal overflow and clear primary CTA.

## SEO Placement Rules

- Put primary keyword near the beginning of the `title`.
- Include keyword variants in `H2` headings naturally.
- Use readable URL slugs in lowercase.
- Add concise `alt` text with intent, not keyword stuffing.
- Add 3-6 internal links from collection page to variant pages and back.

## Performance Rules

- Render headline and descriptive content before loading heavy embeds.
- Reserve fixed space for embeds to avoid layout shift.
- Lazy-load non-critical scripts.

## Writing Style

- Clear, practical English.
- No hype claims and no copied vendor descriptions.
- Explain controls, objective, and one strategy tip.
